Field recordings from Freesound (https://freesound.org), all released under Creative Commons 0
(public domain dedication, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Downloaded as the
site's high-quality previews, converted to 44.1 kHz mono Ogg Vorbis and trimmed to the part used.
Processed into the mod's sounds by tools/level_assets/recorded.py (Level 0's room tone and its
per-tube buzz by tools/anomaly_assets/level0_audio.py).

                                        https://freesound.org/s/777053/

                                        https://freesound.org/s/452625/  (first 6 s)

                                        https://freesound.org/s/125064/  (first 4 s)

                                        https://freesound.org/s/139970/
